## Gallery entry checklist

- [ ] File is `gallery/entries/<my-github-handle>.json`
- [ ] Caption contains no real prompt text, file paths, client or colleague names
- [ ] Ran `npm run gallery:build` and committed `docs/gallery.html`
- [ ] `npm run gallery:validate` passes locally
